This One Pan Chicken & Gravy is an easy and delicious 30 minute dinner!  INGREDIENTS  1 lb chicken breasts  Salt, pepper, garlic powder  3 tbsp butter 3 tbsp flour  2 cups chicken broth  1/2 tsp each of salt, pepper, oregano, and thyme  1 tsp each of paprika, onion powder, garlic powder  INSTRUCTIONS  Cut chicken breasts in half lengthwise to make them thinner. Season the chicken with some salt, pepper, and garlic powder (I don’t use exact measurements for this part).  In a skillet over medium high heat melt 3 tbsp of butter. Once the butter has melted add 3 tbsp of flour and stir continuously until well combined. Let cook for a few minutes while still stirring.  Add 2 cups of chicken broth and stir well. Season with salt, pepper, oregano, thyme, paprika, onion powder, and garlic powder. Stir well and when it starts bubbling add the chicken to the skillet.  Make sure the chicken is covered in the gravy, cover with a lid, and turn the heat down to medium low. Let this cook for 12-15 minutes or until the chicken reaches an internal temp of 165 degrees. My chicken was ready in 12 minutes, but they were pretty thin.  Shred the chicken and serve over mashed potatoes! Enjoy! Let me know if you try it out.  #chickenandgravy #easyrecipe #dinner #onepanmeal #chickenrecipes

Sheet Pan Parmesan Garlic Chicken Thighs are an easy and delicious dinner!  INGREDIENTS  2 lb boneless chicken thighs  Buffalo Wild Wings Parmesan Garlic sauce  1 tsp each salt, pepper, Italian seasoning, and onion powder  2 tsp each garlic powder and smoked paprika  Small head of broccoli, chopped  24 oz baby potatoes  1 onion, sliced  Olive oil   Parmesan cheese  INSTRUCTIONS  Preheat the oven to 400 degrees F. Spray a large sheet pan with cooking spray.  Wash the baby potatoes and quarter them. Slice an onion and chop your broccoli. Be sure to leave the broccoli in slightly larger pieces. Add all of the veggies to the sheet pan and drizzle some olive oil over them. Season the veggies with about half of the seasoning blend.  Next, add the chicken thighs to a bowl and season with the rest of the seasoning. Add enough Parmesan Garlic sauce to coat the chicken. Stir until the chicken is well coated in seasoning and sauce.  Bake at 400 degrees F for about 35 minutes, or until the chicken reaches an internal temp of at least 185 degrees F. Broil for just a few minutes if desired. Top everything with some shredded Parmesan cheese. Enjoy!  #sheetpanmeal #dinner #parmesangarlic #chickenthighs #easyrecipes

Here’s a really simple and delicious dinner idea! Let me know if you give it a go 😄 Chris x CREAM CHEESE CHICKEN | Serves 4 INGREDIENTS ➡️CHICKEN: 2x 250g/9oz Chicken Breasts, brought close to room temp 1/2 tsp EACH: Smoked Paprika, Salt 1/4 tsp EACH: Garlic Powder, Onion Powder, Dried Oregano, Black Pepper, plus more to serve 1/8 tsp Dried Thyme 1 tbsp EACH: Unsalted Butter, Olive Oil ➡️SAUCE: 2 Shallots, very finely diced 180ml / 3/4 cup Chicken Stock (use low-salt if sensitive to salt) 1x 165g/5.8oz tub of full-fat Cream Cheese, brought close to room temp (I use Philadelphia) 1 tsp Dijon Mustard finely diced Fresh Chives, to serve METHOD 1️⃣Horizontally slice each chicken breast right through the centre to create 4 even-sized breasts. Combine the seasoning mix in a small pot or bowl, then evenly sprinkle over both sides of each breast. 2️⃣Place a large pan over medium-high heat and stir in the butter and oil. Add the chicken and fry for a few minutes on each side, or until lightly charred on the outside and piping hot/white through the centre. Remove and place on a plate to one side then lower the heat to medium. 3️⃣Add the shallots and fry in the leftover fat until soft and golden. Pour in the stock, then stir in the cream cheese until it blends into a sauce. You'll need to give it a good whisk to smooth out all the small lumps. Stir in the dijon, then stir in the resting juices from the chicken. 4️⃣The sauce should be relatively thick already, but if it's not just gently simmer for a couple of minutes. If you over thicken it just stir in a splash more stock or water to thin it out. 5️⃣Add the chicken back in and baste in the sauce, then sprinkle with chives and a pinch of black pepper. Serve up and enjoy!

Creamy Tuscan Chicken 🍗✨ This creamy Tuscan chicken is packed with juicy seasoned chicken, garlic, spinach, and sweet grape tomatoes in a rich Parmesan cream sauce. It’s perfect served over pasta, mashed potatoes, or rice! 😋  🍗 Creamy Tuscan Chicken Ingredients:  Chicken seasoning  * 2 to 3 chicken breasts, sliced in half * Salt & pepper * ½ tsp smoked paprika * 1 tsp garlic powder * 1 tbsp Italian seasoning * 1 tsp dried parsley * ½ tsp chili flakes (optional) Sauce: * 1 tbsp butter * ½ onion, diced * 3 garlic cloves, minced * 1 cup grape tomatoes, halved * 2 cups spinach * 1 cup heavy cream * ¼ cup grated Parmesan * Salt & pepper, to taste * Fresh parsley Directions: Season the chicken with all the spices. Heat a drizzle of olive oil in a skillet and cook the chicken for 4–5 minutes per side until golden and cooked through. Remove and set aside. In the same skillet, melt the butter and sauté the onion and garlic until fragrant. Add the tomatoes and cook for 2–3 minutes, then stir in the spinach until wilted. Pour in the heavy cream and Parmesan, stirring until smooth and creamy. Season with salt and pepper to taste. Return the chicken to the skillet and let simmer for 2–3 minutes. Garnish with fresh parsley and serve over pasta, mashed potatoes, or rice. Enjoy! 🤍

Honey Garlic Chicken! 🍯 🧄  Sticky, sweet, garlicky, and comes together so easy… this one’s a weeknight winner every time!! @Courtney Cook made my recipe the other day and it made me want it all over again!! Serve it over rice with a veggie, so good y’all.  Ingredients:  • 3 lbs boneless, skinless chicken thighs, cut into bite-size pieces  • ½ tbsp garlic salt  • 1 tbsp black pepper  • ¼ cup cornstarch (plus a little extra if you want more crunch)  • 2–3 tbsp vegetable oil (for frying) Sauce:  • ½ cup honey  • ¼ cup soy sauce  • 1 tbsp ginger paste  • 2–3 tbsp minced garlic To Finish:  • Sesame seeds  • Green onions, sliced ⸻ Instructions:  1. Season the chicken In a large bowl, add chicken, garlic salt, black pepper, and cornstarch. Toss until everything is well coated. (Add a little extra cornstarch if you want it extra crispy.)  2. Cook the chicken Heat oil in a large skillet or wok over medium-high heat. Add chicken in batches and cook until browned on both sides with a light crust. Don’t overcrowd the pan. Remove and set aside.  3. Make the sauce Add all the cooked chicken back to the skillet. Pour in honey, soy sauce, ginger paste, and minced garlic. Toss to coat.  4. Simmer Let it simmer for a few minutes until the sauce thickens and gets sticky, coating all the chicken.  5. Finish & serve Top with sesame seeds and green onions. Serve over white rice with your favorite veggie.  #yum #easyrecipe #chicken

Complete dinner in under 30 minutes✨ One pot, simple ingredients, minimal cleanup, and a dinner everyone actually gets excited about. Juicy chicken thighs, cozy penne pasta, and the freshest, creamiest side salad. These are the kinds of meals that end up on repeat in my kitchen because they’re easy, comforting, and just so good🥰 Ingredients 🐓🍝🥗 One pot chicken & pasta 1½ pounds boneless skinless chicken thighs/breast 1 onion, sliced ¼ cup olive oil 1 teaspoon salt 1 teaspoon paprika 1 teaspoon garlic powder ½ teaspoon black pepper 1 package 16 oz penne pasta  4 cups chicken broth or any broth you love ½ cup tomato paste Side salad 🥒🍅🥑 4 Persian cucumbers, chopped About a cup of cherry tomatoes  1 shallot  1 avocado  Olive oil Fresh lemon juice  Fresh lime juice  Salt and pepper Instructions Place the chicken thighs in a bowl. Drizzle with olive oil and season with salt, paprika, garlic powder, and black pepper. Mix until evenly coated. Heat a large pot over medium heat. Add the chicken and sear for a few minutes on each side until golden. Scatter the sliced onion right over the chicken and let it soften in all the flavor. In a separate bowl or measuring cup, whisk together the broth and tomato paste until smooth. Once the chicken is nicely browned, add the pasta directly into the pot. Pour the tomato broth mixture right over the chicken and pasta and bring everything to a boil. Cover, reduce to a simmer, and cook for about 10 minutes until the pasta is tender and the chicken is fully cooked through. While everything cooks, chop the cucumbers cucumbers, cherry tomatoes, shallot, and avocado. Drizzle with olive oil and fresh lemon and lime juice, season with salt and pepper, and toss. That’s it. One pot, one fresh salad, and a full comforting dinner on the table in under 30 minutes💛 #sivanskitchen #easyrecipes #onepotmeal #dinnerideas #quickmeals

Ingredients * 2 lbs boneless, skinless chicken breasts (I use thin-cut) * ½ tsp salt * ½ tsp black pepper * 1 tsp garlic powder * Asparagus, green beans, or broccoli Sauce * ¼ cup chicken broth * ¼ cup Dijon mustard * 3 tbsp honey * 2 tbsp olive oil * 4 cloves garlic, minced or pressed * 1 tsp onion powder * 1 tsp paprika * 1 tsp dried thyme Directions 1. Preheat oven to 400°F. 2. Place the chicken breasts in a 9x13-inch baking dish. Season both sides with the salt, pepper, and garlic powder. 3. In a small bowl, whisk together all of the sauce ingredients until smooth. Pour most of the sauce over the chicken, reserving about ¼ cup for later. Coat the chicken evenly. 4. Cover tightly with foil and bake:  * Thin-cut chicken breasts: 20–25 minutes  * Regular or thick chicken breasts (or thighs): 30–40 minutes 5. 10-15 min before chicken is done remove from the oven, add the vegetables, and drizzle the reserved sauce over the top. 6. Return to the oven uncovered for the 10-15 minutes remaining or until the vegetables are tender and the chicken reaches an internal temperature of 165°F. 7. Serve with roasted potatoes, rice, or your favorite side. Enjoy! #fyp #easydinner #recipes

One Pan Cheesy Parmesan Garlic Chicken & Rice 😮‍💨 INGREDIENTS  1 lb chicken breast, cut into cubes  2 tbsp butter  1 onion, chopped  1/2 tsp each of salt and pepper 1 tsp each of smoked paprika, onion powder, and Italian seasoning   1 tbsp minced garlic BWW Parmesan Garlic Sauce  2 cups of chicken broth  1 cup white jasmine rice, rinsed   1 1/2 cups shredded mozzarella cheese  2 oz cream cheese 4 pieces of bacon, cooked and crumbled Dried parsley  INSTRUCTIONS  If you don’t have any bacon leftover from breakfast cook your bacon, drain the grease, and chop it into small pieces. To keep this recipe even easier you could use bacon bits  Cut 1 lb of chicken into small pieces. Add butter to a skillet over medium-high heat. Add the chicken and spread out evenly in pan. Add the chopped onion and season with salt, pepper, paprika, onion powder, and Italian seasoning.  Once the chicken is almost cooked add the minced garlic and add 2-3 tbsp of Parmesan garlic sauce to the pan and stir. Add the rinsed rice to the center of the skillet and let toast for a couple of minutes. Add the chicken broth to the skillet and stir well. Bring to a boil, reduce heat to medium-low, and cover with a lid.  Let cook covered for about 15-20 minutes or until rice is cooked. Add about a cup of shredded cheese and the cream cheese. Stir well.  Top with more cheese and the crumbled bacon. Cover with the lid to let the cheese melt or pop it in the oven under the broiler for just a few minutes.  Top with dried parsley.  Enjoy! Let me know if you try it out! #easyrecipes #chicken #onepanmeal

This One Pot Marry Me Chicken Gnocchi is creamy, cheesy, packed with flavor, and SO easy 😍 Everything cooks in one pan, including the gnocchi, so you get the creamiest sauce with barely any cleanup. Save this one for your next easy weeknight dinner! One Pot Marry Me Chicken Gnocchi Recipe  Ingredients: 2 boneless, skinless chicken breasts, diced 2 tbsp olive oil 1 tbsp minced garlic Italian seasoning Paprika Salt Pepper Onion powder Garlic powder 1 cup chicken broth 1 cup heavy cream ½ cup sun dried tomatoes, chopped 1 lb potato gnocchi ½ cup freshly grated Parmesan 2 cups fresh spinach Crushed red pepper flakes Directions: Heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Add diced chicken and season with Italian seasoning, paprika, salt, pepper, onion powder and garlic powder. Cook until browned and cooked through. Add minced garlic and cook for about 30 seconds. Add chicken broth, heavy cream, sun dried tomatoes and crushed red pepper flakes. Season the sauce with Italian seasoning, salt, pepper, onion powder and garlic powder. Stir to combine. Add the uncooked gnocchi directly to the pan. Bring to a gentle simmer and cook for 5–7 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the gnocchi is tender and the sauce has thickened. Stir in freshly grated Parmesan until melted and creamy. Add spinach and stir until wilted. #marrymechicken #onepotmeal #easydinner #dinnerrecipe #weeknightdinner

Crockpot Parmesan Garlic Chicken & Potatoes are an easy weeknight dinner!  INGREDIENTS 1 lb chicken breasts 1 bag baby potatoes, quartered (or 4-5 russet potatoes cut into cubes)  olive oil + salt, pepper, garlic powder, smoked paprika (for potatoes) 1/2 tsp each of salt and pepper 1 tsp each of paprika, onion powder, and Italian seasoning  1 tbsp minced garlic  Buffalo Wild Wings Parmesan Garlic Sauce (just enough to cover chicken) 1 cup of shredded mozzarella cheese Dried parsley Parmesan cheese  INSTRUCTIONS  Quarter one bag of baby potatoes and cut chicken into cubes. Spray a crockpot with cooking spray.  Add potatoes the crockpot. Season with olive oil, salt, pepper, garlic powder, and smoked paprika (I don’t use exact measurements for this part). Add minced garlic and stir potatoes and seasonings well.  Add the chicken on top of the potatoes. Season chicken with 1/2 tsp each of salt and pepper, 1 tsp each of smoked paprika, onion powder, and Italian seasoning.  Add some garlic Parmesan sauce. I use just enough of the sauce to cover the chicken. You can always add more sauce if needed once everything is cooked.  Cook on low for about 6 hours or until potatoes are cooked to your liking. Stir everything well.  Top with shredded mozzarella cheese and let it sit just until the cheese is melted.  Top with some dried parsley and Parmesan cheese. Enjoy!  #easyrecipes #dinner #crockpot

Sticky Chicken Tender, seasoned chicken coated in a sweet and savory sticky sauce, served over warm rice and finished with green onions and sesame seeds. Ingredients For the Chicken 1.5 lbs chicken breast, cut into bite-sized pieces 1 teaspoon each onion powder, garlic powder, and teaspoon salt ½ teaspoon each black pepper and paprika  2 tablespoons olive oil About ⅓ cup cornstarch Olive oil, for cooking For the Sticky Sauce ½ cup soy sauce ⅓ cup brown sugar or honey 1 tablespoon hoisin sauce 1 tablespoon ketchup 1 teaspoon ginger paste ½ tablespoon minced garlic 1 tablespoon cornstarch 2 tablespoons butter For Serving Cooked white rice Sliced green onions Sesame seeds Instructions 1. Add the chicken to a large bowl and season with onion powder, garlic powder, salt, black pepper, and paprika. Add 2 tablespoons of olive oil and toss until the chicken is evenly coated. 2. Sprinkle about ⅓ cup cornstarch over the seasoned chicken and toss until each piece is lightly and evenly coated. This helps give the chicken that tender, velvety texture and creates a great coating for the sauce. 3. In a bowl, whisk together the soy sauce, brown sugar or honey, hoisin sauce, ketchup, ginger paste, minced garlic, and 1½ tablespoons cornstarch until smooth. Set aside. 4. Heat a drizzle of olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Cook the chicken in 2 batches so you don't overcrowd the pan. Cook until golden brown on the outside and cooked through. Remove the chicken from the skillet and set aside. 5. Reduce the heat and add 2 tablespoons of butter to the same skillet, scraping up all those flavorful browned bits from the bottom of the pan. 6. Pour the prepared sauce into the skillet. Cook over low heat, whisking frequently, until the sauce begins to bubble and thickens into a glossy, sticky consistency. 7. Add the cooked chicken back to the skillet and toss until every piece is completely coated in the sticky sauce. 8. Spoon the sticky chicken over warm rice and finish with sliced green onion.  #easyrecipe #dinnerideas #quickrecipes #easydinner #dinnerrecipes

Chicken Broccoli Cheddar Dump & Bake 🥦🧀 Easy, creamy, cheesy, and all made in one dish! Perfect for a simple weeknight dinner.  🛒INGREDIENTS: • 2 packs Knorr Broccoli & Cheddar Rice • 2 cans reduced-sodium Cream of Chicken • Chicken broth, using the 2 empty soup cans to measure • 1 lb chicken tenderloins • 1 bag frozen broccoli  • Shredded cheddar cheese 🧂SEASONINGS:  • Chicken seasoning (I used Chicka Licka Bam)  • Garlic powder • Onion powder • Paprika • Dried parsley 👩‍🍳HOW TO MAKE IT: 1. Preheat oven to 375°F. 2. Add both packs of Knorr Broccoli & Cheddar Rice and both cans of reduced-sodium Cream of Chicken to a 9x13 baking dish. 3. Fill each empty Cream of Chicken can with chicken broth, pour the broth into the baking dish, and mix everything well. 4. ✨ Creamy Garlic Chicken & Mashed Potatoes 🤍🧄🥔 🕒 Total Time: ~35 minutes 🍽️ Serves: 4-6 📋 Ingredients: • 2 lbs chicken breasts, sliced in half lengthwise • 2 tbsp olive oil • 2 tbsp butter • 2 tbsp all-purpose flour • 1½ cups chicken broth • 1 cup heavy cream or half-and-half • ½ cup grated parmesan cheese • Garlic salt • Onion powder • Paprika • Black pepper • Mashed potatoes, for serving 👩🏼‍🍳 Directions: 1. Cook chicken 4-5 minutes per side until golden brown and cooked through. Remove from skillet and set aside. 4. Reduce heat to medium. Add butter to the skillet and let melt. 5. Marry Me Chicken 🍅✨ A classic dinner idea made a little lighter and packed with protein! This meal is made in one pan and comes together in about 30 minutes. It's the perfect comfort food meal while also helping you hit your protein goals! Makes 4 servings. 4 small chicken breasts (or 2 large cut in half) 1 tbsp olive oil 1 tsp Italian seasoning ½ tsp paprika ½ tsp garlic powder Salt and black pepper, to taste 3 cloves garlic, minced ¾ cup low-sodium chicken broth ⅓ cup chopped sun-dried tomatoes, drained 1 cup low-fat cottage cheese ½ cup fat-free milk ½ cup freshly grated Parmesan cheese 2 cups fresh spinach Fresh basil, for garnish 1. Blend the cottage cheese and fat-free milk until completely smooth and creamy. 2. Season the chicken with the Italian seasoning, paprika, garlic powder, salt, and pepper. 3. Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat. Cook the chicken for 4 minutes per side until golden. Transfer to a plate. 4. Reduce the heat to low-medium and cook the garlic for about 30 seconds until fragrant. 5. Pour in the chicken broth, scraping up any browned bits from the pan. Stir in the sun-dried tomatoes and simmer for 2-3 minutes. 6. Remove the skillet from the heat and let cool for about five minutes. 7. Slowly whisk the cottage cheese mixture into the skillet until smooth. (Make sure tomato mixture is cool enough before adding the cottage cheese to prevent curdling!) 8. Add the spinach and cook until wilted. Add Parmesan and mix until melted. 9. Return the chicken to the skillet and warm over low heat for 3-4 minutes. Garnish with fresh basil and enjoy! Serve over pasta, rice, vegetables or bread. #marrymechicken #easydinnerideas #onepanmeal

EASY RECIPE BELOW👇😋 𝐂𝐫𝐞𝐚𝐦𝐲 𝐒𝐦𝐨𝐭𝐡𝐞𝐫𝐞𝐝 𝐂𝐡𝐢𝐜𝐤𝐞𝐧 & 𝐑𝐢𝐜𝐞  …this one is PURE comfort food & so easy 🥹🍗🍚 the sauce is rich, herby, a little spice, and so good poured over fluffy rice!!🤍✨ ⸻ 𝐈𝐧𝐠𝐫𝐞𝐝𝐢𝐞𝐧𝐭𝐬: 𝐅𝐨𝐫 𝐭𝐡𝐞 𝐂𝐡𝐢𝐜𝐤𝐞𝐧: • 2 lbs chicken thighs or breasts • 1 tsp salt • ½ tsp black pepper • 1 tsp garlic powder • 1 tsp onion powder • 1 tsp paprika • 1 tsp dried thyme • 1 tsp dried parsley • 2 tbsp olive oil 𝐅𝐨𝐫 𝐭𝐡𝐞 𝐒𝐚𝐮𝐜𝐞: • 2 tbsp butter • 1 small onion, diced • 3 cloves garlic, minced • 2 cups chicken broth • 1 cup heavy cream • 1 tsp dried thyme • 1 tsp dried parsley • ½ tsp salt • ½ tsp black pepper • ½ tsp red pepper flakes • 1 tsp cornstarch + 1 tbsp water (optional to make it thicker) 𝐅𝐨𝐫 𝐭𝐡𝐞 𝐑𝐢𝐜𝐞: • 1½ cups long-grain white rice • 3 cups water or chicken broth ⸻  𝐈𝐧𝐬𝐭𝐫𝐮𝐜𝐭𝐢𝐨𝐧𝐬:  1. Season your chicken with salt, pepper, garlic powder, onion powder, paprika, thyme, and parsley. 2. Heat olive oil in a skillet and sear chicken 4–5 minutes per side until golden. Remove it and set aside with foil over it. 3. In the same pan, add olive oil. Add your diced onion and sauté about 3 minutes until soft. Keep stirring so it doesn’t burn. Then add butter & garlic and cook 30 seconds. 4. Pour in chicken broth to deglaze the pan. Stir in heavy cream, thyme, parsley, salt, pepper, and red pepper flakes. Simmer about 5 minutes. (Add cornstarch slurry if you want it thicker.) 5. Return chicken to the sauce. Cover and simmer on low 10–15 minutes until fully cooked and tender. 6. Cook rice separately… bring liquid to a boil, add rinsed rice, cover and cook about 15 minutes. Let sit 5 minutes, then fluff. 7. Serve chicken over rice and spoon extra creamy sauce on top 🤍 #easydinner #dinnerinspo #easyrecipes #chickenandrice #chickenrecipes

Pre heat air fryer to 380°F. Clean and trim off excess fat from chicken thighs and pat dry. Place chicken on a baking sheet or mixing bowl, add seasonings to taste. My one pan, dump & bake chicken broccoli orzo casserole is the easiest weeknight dinner. Tender chicken, orzo pasta, and broccoli bake together in one dish with no boiling, no sautéing, no extra dishes. Save this chicken broccoli orzo bake for busy nights when you want comfort food without the work! 🙃🧀🥦🍗 #onepanmeals #dumpandbake #busymommeals #easyrecipes #thecookingmawma INGREDIENTS: -serves 4-6- 	•	1.5 cups chicken broth 	•	1-10.5oz can cream of chicken soup 	•	1tbsp chicken bouillon powder 	•	1/2tsp parsley flakes 	•	1/4tsp oregano 	•	1/4tsp rosemary 	•	1/4tsp thyme 	•	1/4tsp garlic powder 	•	1/2tsp onion powder 	•	1 cup broccoli florets (fresh or frozen) 	•	1 cup cooked, shredded chicken (I used rotisserie) 	•	1/2 box (8oz) uncooked orzo pasta 	•	1 cup cheddar cheese INSTRUCTIONS: 	1.	Preheat oven to 425 degrees F. Grease an 8x10 baking dish with nonstick cooking spray. 	2.	Add chicken broth, can of soup and all spices and whisk together. Stir in broccoli, cooked chicken and uncooked orzo. Cover tightly with foil and bake for 30 minutes. 	3.	Uncover after 30 minutes and stir gently with a fork. Sprinkle cheese on top and bake uncovered for another 5 minutes. Turn on the broiler for another 2 minutes to create a crispy, brown topping. Enjoy!
